auditNotes: Evidence is attached only where an existing automated test directly supports the stated scope. Source-contract checks prove the tested source wiring/guard clauses, not live runtime behavior. PostgreSQL integration and unit evidence are labeled separately. Partial/helper/database-only evidence is not a claim of full end-to-end verification. Features without testEvidence remain unaudited at the feature-row level; auditComplete remains false until every feature has direct evidence. Additional isolated-command evidence is sourced from scripts/live-command-test.js and the Frieren isolated command audit workflow. It uses synthetic Discord interactions and the isolated frieren_test schema; it is not a live Discord API test. The isolated command runner verifies only the explicit database assertions named in its behavioralChecks; it does not imply that every option or every branch of each command was exercised.
